title: Rewrite etl4/vault/postgres_sink.py to staged INSERT ON CONFLICT per-ym
objective: Rewrite etl4/vault/postgres_sink.py so each target (dim_aircraft, fact_trajectory_enriched) loads via the architecture.md section 4 staged pattern: BEGIN -> CREATE TEMP TABLE stg_<target> LIKE <target> ON COMMIT DROP -> COPY -> INSERT ... SELECT DISTINCT ON (<pk>) ... ORDER BY <pk>, <tiebreaker> ON CONFLICT (<pk>) DO UPDATE SET <non_pk_assignments> -> watermark.set(sink, <target>, ym, row_count, conn) in the SAME txn -> COMMIT.
unblocks: run_e2e.py / orchestration DAG callers will pass --ym under T-22

integration_points.writes: Postgres dim_aircraft (DO UPDATE overwrite icao24, COALESCE registration/typecode); fact_trajectory_enriched (DO UPDATE position+kinematics, COALESCE callsign/typecode/registration, ym=EXCLUDED.ym); pipeline_watermarks('sink', <target>, ym, row_count) same txn

etl4/orchestration/dags/*.py (BashOperator; must pass --ym under T-22 rewire)

contract_deviations: None against architecture.md section 4. Fixed in-flight: _display helper for pretty log path - earlier version used Path.relative_to(ROOT) which raised when callers (e.g. smoke tests) pass a marts_dir outside the repo root.
notes: CLI contract: --ym required (YYYY-MM format enforced by _YM_RE). --only, --dsn, --marts-dir preserved. Per-ym loop is caller's responsibility (architecture 4.1). The staged pattern uses CREATE TEMP TABLE ... ON COMMIT DROP so an uncommitted retry does not leak staging state. Watermark write lives inside the same cursor context as the INSERT, so a cursor error rolls back both halves atomically.
